content.title: A MESSAGE LATER
content.description: A few days later, {candidate_name} sends {character_name} a message. They say they enjoyed meeting and ask if they would like to spend some time together again.

content.title: DINNER FOR TWO
content.description: {character_name} and {candidate_name} meet for dinner. As the evening goes on, the conversation becomes more personal. There is an ease between them that is becoming difficult to ignore.

content.title: COFFEE AND CONVERSATION
content.description: They meet at a quiet café. Without the noise of their first encounter around them, the conversation has more room to breathe. {candidate_name} seems comfortable, but neither of them has said what this is yet.

choices.title: FLIRT A LITTLE
choices.description: Make the mood a little more romantic.

content.title: A LITTLE CLOSER
content.description: The conversation takes a more personal turn. {candidate_name} shares something they do not usually tell people they have only recently met. The moment changes the tone between them.

content.title: KEEPING IT CASUAL
content.description: Some time passes. {character_name} and {candidate_name} continue seeing each other from time to time, but neither has made a clear move. Eventually, {candidate_name} asks what {character_name} actually wants from this.

choices.title: I WANT SOMETHING MORE
choices.description: Say that you want this to become more.

content.title: MORE THAN FRIENDS
content.description: The question is finally out in the open. {candidate_name} admits they have been hoping the connection between them might become something more than a few casual meetings.

content.title: SOME TIME LATER
content.description: Some time has passed since {character_name} asked to slow things down. They have continued seeing each other, but the question they avoided has not disappeared. {candidate_name} brings it up again.

choices.title: I STILL NEED TIME
choices.description: Keep things where they are for now.

content.title: THE FIRST FEW MONTHS
content.description: A few months have passed since {character_name} and {candidate_name} decided to give the relationship a chance. Things have settled into a comfortable rhythm, but they are still learning what being together actually means.

choices.title: LET THINGS DEVELOP NATURALLY
choices.description: Let the relationship find its own pace.

content.title: GETTING CLOSER
content.description:
They have started spending much more time together. {candidate_name} has become a familiar part of {character_name}'s daily life, and the relationship no longer feels new.

One evening, {candidate_name} suggests meeting some of {character_name}'s family.

choices.title: ASK WHY IT MATTERS
choices.description: Ask why meeting the family matters.

content.title: A CHANGE OF PLANS
content.description: {character_name} and {candidate_name} had plans to spend the evening together, but something else has come up for {character_name}. {candidate_name} is clearly disappointed.

choices.title: KEEP YOUR ORIGINAL PLANS
choices.description: Keep the plans you already made.

choices.title: MAKE IT UP TO THEM
choices.description: Find a better way to make it up to them.

content.title: SOMETHING FEELS OFF
content.description: Lately, {candidate_name} has seemed more distant. When {character_name} finally asks what is wrong, they admit that the relationship has started to feel one-sided.

content.title: MEETING THE FAMILY
content.description:
{candidate_name} joins {character_name} for a family gathering. The first few minutes are a little awkward, but the evening soon becomes easier.

By the end of it, {candidate_name} seems relieved.

choices.title: LET THEM HANDLE IT
choices.description: Let them find their own place in the room.

content.title: WHAT ARE WE BUILDING?
content.description: During a quiet moment, {candidate_name} asks a question that has been sitting between them for some time: where does {character_name} think this relationship is going?

choices.title: I SEE A FUTURE WITH YOU
choices.description: Say that you see a future together.

choices.title: I'M HAPPY AS WE ARE
choices.description: Keep the relationship as it is for now.

choices.title: I'M NOT SURE
choices.description: Admit that you are not sure yet.

content.title: A GOOD NIGHT
content.description: What began as an ordinary evening turns into one of those nights that feels unexpectedly important. On the way home, {candidate_name} admits how happy they have been lately.

choices.title: SAY YOU FEEL THE SAME
choices.description: Say that you feel the same.

choices.title: ENJOY THE MOMENT
choices.description: Enjoy the moment without pushing further.

choices.title: TALK ABOUT THE FUTURE
choices.description: Talk about what might come next.

content.title: AN HONEST CONVERSATION
content.description: The conversation is uncomfortable at first. Both of them finally say things they have been avoiding, and it becomes clear that the relationship cannot simply continue without changing.

choices.title: LISTEN AND COMPROMISE
choices.description: Try to find a way forward together.

content.title: PART OF YOUR LIFE
content.description:
Without either of them really noticing when it happened, {candidate_name} has become part of {character_name}'s everyday life. Family gatherings, plans and ordinary days now often include them.

One evening, they begin talking seriously about what comes next.

content.title: MORE TIME TOGETHER
content.description:
More time passes, and the relationship remains steady. There is no crisis and no dramatic change; they simply continue building a life around each other.

Eventually, the question of the future returns.

choices.title: KEEP DATING
choices.description: Keep dating without forcing the next step.

content.title: A DIFFICULT CHOICE
content.description: Neither {character_name} nor {candidate_name} wants to pretend the disagreement did not happen. They still care about each other, but both know that something has to give.

content.title: THE NEXT STEP
content.description: The conversation turns to marriage. {candidate_name} does not dismiss the idea. Instead, they ask whether {character_name} is truly ready for that kind of commitment.

choices.title: NOT YET
choices.description: Keep dating and return to the question later.

content.title: A QUESTION TO ASK
content.description: {character_name} has made a decision. The question is no longer whether the relationship matters, but whether this is the right moment to make it permanent.

choices.title: WAIT FOR A BETTER TIME
choices.description: Wait and return to the question later.

content.title: THE ANSWER
content.description:
For a moment, {candidate_name} says nothing. Then they smile and give {character_name} the answer they were hoping to hear.

There is one more decision to make before the wedding day arrives.

content.title: THE WEDDING
content.description:
The wedding day has arrived. Family and friends gather as {character_name} and {candidate_name} prepare to begin a new chapter together.

How much the family spends on the celebration is up to you.
